notes.title: 🛠️ Update 1.1.1 – Multi-Language Support 🌍
notes.notes:
Hello!

Update 1.1.1 is now live, and it focuses on making the game more accessible to players around the world.

🌐 New Languages Available:
The game is now fully translated into the following languages:

English

French

Japanese

Korean

Traditional Chinese

Simplified Chinese

Russian

Italian

German

Polish

Portuguese

Portuguese (Brazil)

Spanish

Spanish (Latin America)

✏️ Text & Font Updates:
Font styles and text design have been adjusted to better match each language, improving readability and overall presentation.

🌍 Language Selection:
A language selection option is now available in the Mode Selection Menu.

On first launch, the game will automatically choose a language based on your system’s settings.

After that, the chosen language is saved and used for future sessions.

💬 Feedback & Translation Issues:
If you notice any translation mistakes or other language-related issues, feel free to reach out on X, or leave a comment/review so I can fix it as soon as possible.

Thanks for playing, and I hope this update makes the experience better for more players around the world!

notes.title: 📝 Update 1.1.0 – Performance Optimization & Visual Fixes
notes.notes:
💡 Major Performance Optimizations!

I’ve worked on optimizing several maps to significantly improve game performance:

~+43% average FPS increase across the game

~-34.8% reduction in rendering latency, making gameplay smoother and more responsive

🗺️ Zone-by-zone highlights:

Lobby: ~+147% FPS, rendering latency cut by 63%

Street: ~+50% FPS, -33% latency

Enchanted: ~+52% FPS, -32% latency

Medieval: ~+45% FPS, -32% latency

Casino: ~+11% FPS, slight latency improvement

These improvements apply to both main zones and their associated mini-games.

🎨 Visual & Content Updates:

Improved and corrected 48 character images (Furry and Hentai styles) to fix generation issues and enhance visual coherence (e.g. strange limbs, extra fingers/toes, distorted eyes).

Fixed a minor graphical bug during dice selection in arena combat: previously, spamming the selection and switching to an attack could leave the last die permanently highlighted green. This was a purely visual issue and did not affect combat resolution.

Minor UI/UX adjustments (e.g. combat camera icon, arena fighter name text alignment).

Medieval mini-game music now loops properly.

🧡 A big thank you to everyone who purchased the game — your support means a lot to me!
If you enjoy the experience, feel free to leave a review on the Steam page.
And of course, if you have any feedback or encounter anything odd, I’m always happy to read your messages. Thanks again! 😊

Note: The internal version number is still 1.0.0 in-game, but this update marks version 1.1.0 in terms of content and improvements.
